messages:
Nina (Finance): Heads up  Cadence called: they received two March invoices. One is $0 and the other full. AP won't pay until we confirm. Can someone triage?
billing-bot: Alert: invoice_generation_alert=2 customer_id=cadence_co run=batch_2026_03_18 severity=medium
Ravi (Support): Ticket #6023: https://support.redwood.ai/t/6023  PDFs attached. The zero invoice lacks reserved node lines and VAT.
Theo (Billing Eng): Checking DB: invoice 2026-03-18005 total_cents=0 lines=2 batch=batch_2026_03_18_0230; invoice 2026-03-18005-A total_cents=860000 lines=8 same batch.
Claire (Payments): Capture only on the -A invoice (charge ch_9a8). No refunds yet.
Nina (Finance): Priority: void the zero invoice, regenerate canonical PDF with audit note, and prepare credit memo if AP requires. Customer needs corrected docs by EOD PST.
Theo (Billing Eng): Plan: mark 2026-03-18005 void, regen PDF for 2026-03-18005-A with audit_line, run ledger backfill. Will pause any promo/tax patch jobs until fixed.
Theo (Billing Eng): Void script run: success. Regenerated PDF and uploaded to ticket. Audit note: "voided duplicate incomplete invoice; canonical invoice retained (batch batch_2026_03_18_0230)"
Ravi (Support): Sent to Cadence. They replied: "Please confirm VAT lines and that credit memo will appear on next statement."
Nina (Finance): VAT present on canonical invoice. Creating credit memo CM-2026-03-0622 and linking to account. Claire will process refunds if needed.
Claire (Payments): Will stand by. No refund required now.
Theo (Billing Eng): Opening PR to make the writer idempotent (use batch_run dedupe) and add a short lock on post-process. ETA 24h.
Nina (Finance): Thanks. Please paste ledger confirmation here once backfill and credit memo are posted so I can close the ticket. :white_check_mark:
